title: Perplexity New v1.1 Decision Model Tops Hugging Face Index at $0.02 per Million Tokens
summary:
A new multimodal decision model from Perplexity has taken the top spot on the Hugging Face Decision Index 0.3 benchmark. The company launched pplx-decider-v1.1-27b as an open-weights model and cut its API price to $0.02 per million input tokens, or $20 per 1 billion tokens, down from the previous $0.04 per million rate for the first version.

The updated model is a generative discriminator fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B with a 250k context window that can analyze images. In an unofficial benchmark playing Tetris against seven other decision models, the system consistently performed the best. The first version of the tool previously outperformed the Jev model and scored 85.71% across early public benchmarks.
